title: Make the Tests Pass: Phone
prompt: Implement normalize_phone(raw) so the hidden test suite passes: keep only digits, but keep a leading + if present.

tests.name: suite passes
tests.code:
cases = [("+84 901-234-567", "+84901234567"), ("(028) 38-22-77", "028382277"), ("123", "123")]
for raw, want in cases:
    got = normalize_phone(raw)
    assert got == want, f"normalize_phone({raw!r}) = {got!r}, want {want!r}"
assert normalize_phone("no digits") == "", "no digits -> empty string"
tests.hint: keep str digits; if the original starts with '+', prefix the result.
